text: my chest is tight and the room feels small
refreshing the results page every two minutes
I keep rehearsing what I'll say tomorrow
I could scream, they ignored everything I said in the meeting
slammed the door so hard the frame cracked
my phone hasn't buzzed all weekend
the group chat went quiet when I joined
I fell asleep on my laptop again
my eyes are burning and it's only Tuesday
her room is still exactly how she left it
I deleted our photos and then cried looking for them
the smell of my grandma's kitchen came back out of nowhere
drove past my old school today
I'm dancing in the kitchen and I don't care who sees
sitting by the window with nowhere to be
the hard part is over, spring is coming
